{{Quote|If we ''block'' the Republic's tibanna supplies it will ''cripple'' their forces and their capacity for ''interplanetary travel''.|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]|<ref name="In the Air" />}}
